title: Etale morphisms are locally of finite presentation
statement:
An etale morphism of schemes is locally of finite presentation; hence
an etale morphism $U\to X$ which is quasi-compact, with $X$ of
finite type over a field $K$, has $U$ of finite type over $K$.

proof.text: Mathlib supplies Smooth f from Etale f and LocallyOfFinitePresentation f from Smooth f, proving the first conjunct. LocallyOfFinitePresentation f also supplies LocallyOfFiniteType f. For the second conjunct, install the explicit quasi-compactness of f and the quasi-compactness and locally finite type hypotheses on g as local instances. The Mathlib instances quasiCompact_comp and locallyOfFiniteType_comp give the two properties of f ≫ g.
